audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Printed reconstruction matrix can be singular for Im omega > 0; The Sobolev semigroup bootstrap lacks a valid forcing estimate; Real part of the potential has n-squared size within the claimed n-to-three-halves regime
limitations: P1 — Printed reconstruction matrix can be singular for Im omega > 0 — Limits: Not a global H01 eigenmode counterexample; not a counterexample to Theorem 1.1 or 1.2. Local algebraic reconstruction has no Assumption A restriction.

P2 — The Sobolev semigroup bootstrap lacks a valid forcing estimate — Limits: No counterexample to the actual semigroup bound or nonlinear theorem. The annulus family disproves the unqualified embedding inference, not a claim that all such fields are the manuscript's specific forcing. Full replacement of the higher derivative proof not claimed.
P3 — Real part of the potential has n-squared size within the claimed n-to-three-halves regime — Limits: No counterexample to outer coercivity or ring-mode existence established.
P4 — Wrong leading sign for the eigenvalue correction in the potential error — Limits: No change of qualitative Rouche zero count inferred from the sign alone.
P5 — Complex Hermite argument requires a half-angle — Limits: Intended oscillator spectrum not disproved.
P6 — Strict pitch variation excludes the advertised constant-pitch example — Limits: Not an admissible counterexample to the original theorem; exact scope mismatch and local correction.
Limitations: Initial review, not independent scientific acceptance
Limitations: No author code execution; no claim to have rerun authors' numerics
Limitations: Exact bound preprint only; no journal equivalence
Limitations: No counterexample to either principal instability conclusion
Limitations: All external dependency theorems not independently reproved
Limitations: No definitive conclusion about exceptional (plus/minus1,0) modes
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

Recorded check: Printed reconstruction matrix can be singular for Im omega > 0

General Fourier reconstruction from (1.7), r>0, real smooth vortex profiles, n,alpha>0, Im omega>0; separate Assumption A not used in this general identity.

Recorded check: The Sobolev semigroup bootstrap lacks a valid forcing estimate

1<Q<2, fixed Fourier mode; Lemma 3.5 requires LQ intersect Hk growth estimate.

Recorded check: Real part of the potential has n-squared size within the claimed n-to-three-halves regime

Any background satisfying the local Assumption A conditions; omega=omega_app; r_n=r0+c n^(-1/2), fixed 0<c<C^-1, n sufficiently large.

Recorded check: Wrong leading sign for the eigenvalue correction in the potential error

r=r0, mu_m=O(n^-1/2), omega_hat=d n^-1/2 with fixed sufficiently small nonzero d in the allowed disk.

Recorded check: Complex Hermite argument requires a half-angle

zeta=pi/4 is within (-pi/2,pi/2); m=1.

Recorded check: Strict pitch variation excludes the advertised constant-pitch example

Displayed Batchelor profiles with positive constant q.

repair.content:
Replace alpha^3 W r by -i alpha^2 W r and use determinant -(n^2/r+alpha^2 r)gamma. Independent exact pressure elimination confirms (1.9) and the Liouville transformation.

Use modewise velocity derivative gain: nonzero axial modes reduce to a 2D Bessel velocity kernel mapping LQ to L2; for zero axial modes combine L^(2Q/(2-Q)) velocity with decaying coefficients in L^(Q/(Q-1)). Rewrite the higher derivative bootstrap, and retain spectral slack 0<delta<2a-S.

Replace the two-sided size assertion by a bound Re k>=-C1 n^(3/2) on the negative part, combine with the positive imaginary part, and adjust the figure interpretation.

Correct both f and g leading terms consistently; use integral complex Taylor remainder.

Use exp(i zeta/2) consistently.

Change middle strict inequality to <=; proof needs positive bounds rather than strict variation.
